same_law.reason: All three cards describe the same Santa Ana ordinance banning algorithmic rent-setting software. r-0102 reflects the Feb. 17, 2026 first reading, r-0101 the March 3, 2026 adoption, and r-0103 cites it as Ord. No. NS-3090, effective April 2, 2026. The penalty figure of up to $1,000 per violation is consistent across the cards. The in-force official text (r-0101) does not mention the 'per month' wording from the law-firm alert.
